scripts.db:shell: docker compose --project-directory .. exec postgres sh -c 'exec psql -U "$POSTGRES_USER" -d "$POSTGRES_DB"'
scripts.db:check-test: node --env-file-if-exists=../.env -e "const testDb = process.env.POSTGRES_TEST_DB ?? 'lamplighter_test'; if (!process.env.POSTGRES_DB || !testDb || testDb === process.env.POSTGRES_DB) throw new Error('POSTGRES_TEST_DB must be different from POSTGRES_DB');"
scripts.migrate: npm run db:check-test && npm run db:up && docker compose --project-directory .. run --rm migrate up && docker compose --project-directory .. run --rm migrate-test up
scripts.migrate:test: npm run db:check-test && npm run db:up && docker compose --project-directory .. run --rm migrate-test up
scripts.migrate:down: npm run db:check-test && npm run db:up && docker compose --project-directory .. run --rm migrate rollback && docker compose --project-directory .. run --rm migrate-test rollback
scripts.migrate:status: docker compose --project-directory .. run --rm migrate status && docker compose --project-directory .. run --rm migrate-test status
